## mcrl aws create

Create a AWS integration.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws create [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a AWS integration from flags, or from a JSON or YAML file in the API's format
with -f. Flags override the file's fields.

API: POST /api/v0/aws-integrations
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl aws create -f aws.yaml
  mcrl aws create --name prod --region ap-northeast-1 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/mackerel --external-id "$(mcrl aws external-id --jq .externalId)"

Flags:
      --external-id string              external ID for the IAM role
  -f, --file string                     JSON or YAML file in the API's format ("-" for stdin)
      --memo string                     memo
      --name string                     name
      --region string                   AWS region, e.g. ap-northeast-1
      --role-arn mcrl aws external-id   IAM role ARN (with an external ID from mcrl aws external-id)
```

## mcrl aws delete

Delete a AWS integration.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws delete <AWS-integration>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a AWS integration. The output is the deleted object.

API: DELETE /api/v0/aws-integrations/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl aws delete prod
  mcrl aws delete 3Ja1bAxcdef --yes
```

## mcrl aws edit

Edit a AWS integration in $EDITOR.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws edit <aws-integration>

Open the current AWS integration as YAML in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (default vi), then
show the changes and send them after confirmation.

The whole object is sent back, including fields mcrl does not know about,
so nothing is lost. Read-only fields (id) are hidden. If the file does not
parse, the editor opens again with the error at the top. Saving an empty file
or leaving it unchanged cancels.

API: PUT /api/v0/aws-integrations/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl AWS-integration edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
  EDITOR='code --wait' mcrl AWS-integration edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl aws excludable-metrics

List the metrics that can be excluded per AWS service.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws excludable-metrics [--service <aws-service>] [flags]

List the metrics that can be excluded, as {"<AWS service>": [metric, ...]}.

API: GET /api/v0/aws-integrations-excludable-metrics
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl aws excludable-metrics
  mcrl aws excludable-metrics --service EC2

Flags:
      --service string   only this AWS service, e.g. EC2, RDS, ALB
```

## mcrl aws external-id

Generate an external ID for an IAM role integration.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws external-id

Generate an external ID for the IAM role trust policy. It can be reused until every integration using it is deleted.

API: POST /api/v0/aws-integrations-external-id
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl aws external-id
  mcrl aws external-id --jq .externalId
```

## mcrl aws get

Show a AWS integration.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws get <aws-integration>

Aliases:
  get, show

Show a AWS integration by ID or name.

A reference that looks like an ID (11 alphanumeric characters) is looked up
as an ID first. Prefix it with "id:" or "name:" to force either.

API: GET /api/v0/aws-integrations/<id>, GET /api/v0/aws-integrations
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl aws get production
  mcrl aws get 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl aws list

List AWS integrations.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws list

Aliases:
  list, ls

List AWS integrations.

API: GET /api/v0/aws-integrations
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl aws list
  mcrl aws list --jq '.[] | {id, name, region}'
```

## mcrl aws update

Update a AWS integration.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl aws update <AWS-integration> [flags]

Update a AWS integration. The current AWS integration is fetched and the flags (and -f fields) are
applied on top, so only the fields to change need to be given. --replace
sends the -f file as the complete object instead.

API: PUT /api/v0/aws-integrations/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl aws update prod --memo 'production account'
  mcrl aws update prod -f services.yaml

Flags:
      --external-id string              external ID for the IAM role
  -f, --file string                     JSON or YAML file with the fields to change ("-" for stdin)
      --memo string                     memo
      --name string                     name
      --region string                   AWS region, e.g. ap-northeast-1
      --replace                         send the -f file as the complete object without merging
      --role-arn mcrl aws external-id   IAM role ARN (with an external ID from mcrl aws external-id)
```
